description.tr: Nizâmiye medrese ağını kurdu — İslam dünyasının ilk sistematik yüksek öğretim kurumları zinciri, Avrupa üniversitesinin modeli. 30 yıl iki sultana vezirlik yaparak Selçuklu devletini dönüştürdü || Birçok tarihçi Nizâmülmülk'ü 'İslam tarihinin en önemli devlet adamı' olarak adlandırır. || [Tarih notu] Lambton'un 1984 bölümü ve Darke'ın 1960 Siyâsetnâme çevirisi standart referanslardır.
description.en: Created the Nizamiyya madrasa network — the first systematically organized chain of higher education institutions in the Islamic world, model for the European university. Served as vizier for 30 years across two sultans, transforming the Seljuk state || Many historians call Nizam al-Mulk 'the most important statesman in Islamic history.' His Nizamiyya network was a deliberate Sunni intellectual counter-offensive against Fatimid Ismaili proselytism via al-Azhar. The Baghdad Nizamiyya housed 3,000 students at its peak under Ghazali. His iqta land-grant system influenced the Ottoman timar. Assassinated by a Hasan-i Sabbah fidai on Oct 14, 1092. || [Historiographical note] Lambton's 1984 chapter in Cambridge History of Iran and Darke's 1960 translation of the Siyasatnama remain standard references. The legendary (but apocryphal) schoolmate story linking Nizam, Khayyam, and Hasan-i Sabbah has been debunked — Nizam was 32 years older than Sabbah.
description.ar: أسّس شبكة المدارس النظامية — أول سلسلة منظمة للتعليم العالي في العالم الإسلامي || يسميه كثير من المؤرخين 'أهم رجل دولة في التاريخ الإسلامي.' شبكة النظامية كانت هجومًا فكريًا سنيًا مضادًا للدعاية الإسماعيلية الفاطمية
